decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of the development (excluding demolition and ground preparation) full details of the materials shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The building shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These works shall then be carried out within three months of the occupation of the development.  These details shall include means of enclosure; hard surfacing material and minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc). Soft landscape works shall include planting plans;  schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate and an implementation programme.
Condition : 5 - The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 6 - The electric car charging point shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings.  The electric car charging point shall then be maintained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the occupation of the development full details of cycle storage shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  This shall be implemented as approved prior to the occupation of the development.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out and used in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan and Construction Logistics Plan submitted with the application.
description: Erection of a single storey front extension, a single storey rear extension and a single storey side extension, installation of two freestanding canopies and installation of additional hardstanding.
